items.title: People Can't Identify AI Poetry, but Enjoy It Less When Told It's by an AI
items.raw_excerpt: A study shows that people cannot reliably identify AI-generated poetry, but they enjoy it less when told it was written by an AI, indicating a bias against AI-created art.

title_i18n.en: People Can't Identify AI Poetry, but Enjoy It Less When Told It's by an AI
title_i18n.zh: 人们无法辨别AI诗歌，但被告知是AI所作后享受程度降低。
title_i18n.es: La gente no puede identificar la poesía generada por IA, pero la disfruta menos cuando se le dice que es de una IA.

excerpt_i18n.en: A study shows that people cannot reliably identify AI-generated poetry, but they enjoy it less when told it was written by an AI, indicating a bias against AI-created art.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 研究发现，人们无法准确区分AI创作的诗歌与人类诗歌，但一旦被告知是AI所作，他们的欣赏程度会显著降低。这表明人们对AI创作存在一定的偏见。

items.title: Add flag for AI-generated articles
items.raw_excerpt: Should HN add the ability to flag articles as AI-generated? This doesn't have to act as a regular flag, i.e., it won't de-rank the article; it could just show up as an indicator, allowing others (like myself) who don't like reading AI-generated text, to skip it. Open questions: 1. Why is the regular voting system not enough? 2. Should HN change in response to the gen AI era? It has been successful not changing fundamentals.

title_i18n.zh: 为AI生成的文章添加标记
title_i18n.es: Añadir bandera para artículos generados por IA
